name: eng-2349
title: Fix overlapping controls in Roam's tentative relation rows

prepare.why: the extension has a proof database session for this graph; the proof database runs without edge functions, so this signs in the way create-space would
Stored Relations is on, so the popover shows Add relation and pending rows
the Discourse context overlay is on, so page refs to nodes get the popover button
a claim with two imported relations pending review, one with a long title, and none accepted

apply.js: (async () => { const claim = '[[CLM]] - PK pending review claim'; const claimUid = await proof.page.ensure(claim, ['A claim with imported relations waiting for review and none accepted.']); const longUid = await proof.page.ensure('[[EVD]] - Structured onboarding notes cut the time a new contributor needs before a first merged change from three weeks to under two - [[@PK baseline source]]', ['Evidence with a long title.']); const shortUid = await proof.page.ensure('[[EVD]] - Pairing sessions shorten onboarding - [[@PK baseline source]]', ['Evidence with a short title.']); await proof.relations.removeTouching([claimUid]); const schemaUid = proof.relations.schemaId('Supports') || 'Supports-1'; await proof.relations.createTentative({ sourceUid: longUid, destinationUid: claimUid, schemaUid }); await proof.relations.createTentative({ sourceUid: shortUid, destinationUid: claimUid, schemaUid }); await proof.page.recreate('PK pending review scratch', ['Waiting for review: [[' + claim + ']]']); })()

cases.title: Add relation sits above the pending review list
cases.caption: On a claim with no accepted relations, the context popover now stacks Add relation above the pending review list, so the button no longer covers the rows, even with a long title in a narrow window.

steps.why: open a page that references the claim
wait for the overlay button next to the reference
wait for the pending review list

expect.js: (() => { const pop = document.querySelector('.roamjs-discourse-context-popover'); proof.assert(pop, 'The context popover is not open.'); const add = proof.byText('button', 'Add relation', pop); const pending = pop.querySelector('.roamjs-discourse-tentative-relations'); proof.assert(add, 'The popover has no Add relation button.'); proof.assert(pending, 'The popover has no pending review list.'); proof.assert(!proof.overlaps(add, pending), 'Add relation overlaps the pending review list.'); proof.assert(proof.rect(add).bottom <= proof.rect(pending).top + 1, 'Add relation is not above the pending review list.'); })()

cases.title: Remove on the Pairing sessions row removes that relation
cases.caption: Each row's buttons act on their own relation: removing the Pairing sessions row leaves the other relation pending.

expect.js: (() => { const claimUid = proof.uid('[[CLM]] - PK pending review claim'); const left = proof.relations.touching([claimUid]); proof.assert(left.length === 1, 'Expected one relation left on the claim, found ' + left.length + '.'); proof.assert(left[0].tentative === 'true', 'The remaining relation is no longer pending.'); proof.assert(left[0].sourceUid === proof.uid('[[EVD]] - Structured onboarding notes cut the time a new contributor needs before a first merged change from three weeks to under two - [[@PK baseline source]]'), 'Remove took the wrong row.'); })()

cases.title: Accept on the remaining row accepts that relation
cases.caption: Accept works on its row too. The relation leaves the pending list and becomes a normal relation.

expect.js: (() => { const claimUid = proof.uid('[[CLM]] - PK pending review claim'); const left = proof.relations.touching([claimUid]); proof.assert(left.length === 1, 'Expected one relation on the claim, found ' + left.length + '.'); proof.assert(left[0].tentative === undefined, 'The relation is still pending after Accept.'); })()
